voice.instruct: A warm, friendly woman in her early thirties, a mum talking to other parents about something that really worked. Natural, conversational and upbeat, with a gentle smile in her voice. Clear, close to the microphone, quick confident pace. Not sing-song, not theatrical, not a radio announcer.

segments.name: hook1
segments.text: [hook] What if tonight's / bedtime story / was about *your* *kid?*

segments.name: hook2
segments.text: [hook] POV: / your child hears / their own *name* / in a bedtime story.

segments.name: hook3
segments.text: [hook] Reading the same book / for the *four* *hundredth* time?

segments.name: hook4
segments.text: [hook] Bedtime battle / every *single* night? / Try this.

segments.name: hook5
segments.text: [hook] Type three things / about your child. / Get *this.*

segments.name: hook6
segments.text: [hook] Parents of three to six year olds, / save this / for *tonight.*

segments.name: hook8A
segments.text: [hook] Scared of the dark? / Try a story / where *she* is / the brave one.

segments.name: midA
segments.text: [b1] This is Mia. / She's four, / and she's scared / of the *dark.* / Every single night. [b2] So her mum typed / three things: / Mia, four, red hair, / loves *foxes,* / scared of the dark. [b3] Four minutes later: / *Mia* *and* *the* *Night* *Fox.* [b3b] A fox with a lantern / shows her / the dark is full / of *friendly* things. [b4] And tonight, / Mia switched off / the light / *herself.*

segments.name: cta1
segments.text: [cta] Make your child's / first story / *free.* / Link in bio.

segments.name: cta2
segments.text: [cta] Tell us their name / and what they're / struggling with. / Story ready / in *four* *minutes.*

segments.name: cta3
segments.text: [cta] Comment *STORY* / and we'll send you / the link.
